newsitem.title: CHINA: China says Daya Bay nuclear plant output up.
newsitem.headline: China says Daya Bay nuclear plant output up.

text.p: China's Daya Bay nuclear power plant produced 6.44 billion kilowatt/hours of electricity in the first seven months of 1997, up 612 million kilowatt/hours compared with the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

The plant in the southern Chinese province of Guangdong had run smoothly between January and July and was expected to provide 12 billion kilowatt/hours to the province and the nearby region of Hong Kong by the end of the year, the agency said.

Discharged waste gas had totalled 1.65 percent of the state-set limit, while waste water accounted for just 1.38 percent, it quoted a spokesman for the Guangdong Nuclear Power Joint Venture Co Ltd as saying.
Measurements taken by seven radioactivity monitoring stations near the plant found that radioactivity levels were at the same level as last year, it said but gave no further details.
